flags: GATE: posted $42/$45, holiday +$10 per weekend; RoverPass 'Nightly RV Sites' starts at $45. Cheapest real night $42, under $50. Gateway: none within 40 km (Cincinnati 131 km). GS false; no military stated. Presence: own site + claimed RoverPass booking.

LONG-STAY: mostly seasonal. 110 seasonal lots vs 36 temporary (12 group sites unclear): 36/146 = 25% sold nightly, passes test 4. Test 1 ok; test 2 ok (nightly rate + booking site, no application); test 3 no minimum stated; test 5 no homes sold. Kept; note now says what it mostly is.

WATERFRONT: two ponds; imagery shows only a few sites near the small pond, the swimming pond at the north end. 'not waterfront' holds. Pin OK. Website is this park. Phone 937-338-3115 OK. Note's '$35 tents' dropped.
note: Small campground in farm country at Rossburg (Darke Co), mostly seasonal: 110 seasonal lots and 36 sites for shorter stays, with two ponds, a beach and mini golf. Google 4.8 over 73 (not on RV Life). --Claude
